title: Chart2SVG: Editable SVG Generation from Raster Chart Images
abstract: arXiv:2608.26544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Chart2SVG, a multimodal large language model that converts static raster charts into structurally organized, semantically enriched SVGs that support programmatic editing. By incorporating chart-specific semantic tokens into a vision-language model, Chart2SVG captures both geometric primitives and their functional roles. To support robust structural recovery, we introduce Beagle+, a dataset of 33K canonicalized and structurally distilled chart samples. Our approach combines specialized training objectives with a rendering-aware post-training phase, producing SVGs that are both visually accurate and structurally consistent. To facilitate higher-level manipulations, we construct a Chart Structure Graph (CSG) that exposes visual dependencies, enabling tasks such as interactive exploration, chart repurposing, and layout reuse. translated_title: Chart2SVG：从栅格图表图像生成可编辑的SVG
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Chart2SVG，一种多模态大语言模型，它能将静态栅格图表转换为结构有序、语义丰富的SVG格式，从而支持程序化编辑。通过将图表特定的语义标记融入视觉-语言模型，Chart2SVG同时捕捉几何基元及其功能角色。为了支持稳健的结构恢复，我们引入了Beagle+，一个包含33,000个规范化且结构精简的图表样本的数据集。我们的方法结合了专门的训练目标和渲染感知的后训练阶段，生成的SVG既视觉准确又结构一致。为了促进更高层次的操作，我们构建了一个图表结构图（CSG），它暴露了视觉依赖关系，支持交互式探索、图表重制和布局复用等任务。实验表明，Chart2SVG在重建保真度和下游任务上显著优于基线方法。
tldr: Chart2SVG通过多模态大语言模型和图表专用语义标记，将栅格图表转化为可编辑且结构化的SVG，并引入CSG支持高级操作，显著提升了重建保真度。
en_tdlr: Chart2SVG converts raster charts into editable, structurally organized SVGs using a multimodal LLM with chart-specific semantic tokens and a CSG for advanced manipulations, substantially improving reconstruction fidelity.
